evidence.note: Blue appears only on focus elements: the kicker, the active nav item, the progress bar and the current timeline marker (1); earlier markers turn grey in later steps.
Agent-run dots are light blue, matching the 'Agent Run' legend; links and containers are neutral grey.
One agent's link is highlighted in solid blue (focus), and the mirror's padlock turns red and open to show the zero-day breach (alarm/loss).
A red dot marks the crash of the mirror under the pile of agent files (alarm); there is no other red on the slide.
After the rebuild the padlock goes back to a closed blue/neutral state, so the colour follows the state change.
A faint red x marks the blocked path in the 'no solution' sketch, a failure use; the blue scorer pill in card 1 marks the agent-side success element.
The insight card uses neutral ink only; no role colour is used for emphasis.

rationale: Blue is used only for focus or agent identity (current step, active nav, highlighted path, agent runs), and red only for breach, crash or failure states. No role colour appears as decoration or as a heading emphasis. Each colour therefore appears only in its declared role.
